purpose: Challenge the selected Campaign047 prior-body-to-next-microgap reversal mechanism against the complete terminal and prospective frontier before freezing a formula implementation or reading any Campaign047 candidate, comparison, daily-price, or return value.

selected_mechanism.name: intraday_body_next_microgap_reversal_238p
selected_mechanism.formula: Inside each 120-bar half, align b_t=log(close_t/open_t) with g_(t+1)=log(open_(t+1)/close_t) over 119 transitions. Pool both halves to 238 transitions and return -Corr(b_t,g_(t+1)) using population Pearson correlation.
selected_mechanism.economic_hypothesis: A higher fixed score indicates stronger next-print correction of the preceding one-minute body, potentially distinguishing fast quote or inventory repair from continuation and leaving a more resilient completed-session state for the next-open-to-third-close horizon.
selected_mechanism.selected_bar_grid: exactly 240 raw unadjusted one-minute bars at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00; standalone 09:30 is excluded
selected_mechanism.half_session_rule: Form 119 body/following-gap transitions independently inside each half; never include lunch, overnight, cross-day, or cross-stock transitions.
selected_mechanism.body_rule: b_t=log(close_t/open_t) for the earlier bar of each transition.
selected_mechanism.following_gap_rule: g_(t+1)=log(open_(t+1)/close_t), where the reference close is the same close used in b_t.
selected_mechanism.zero_rule: Retain exact-zero bodies and gaps in fixed support; never drop or bridge them.
selected_mechanism.normalization_rule: Use equal-transition population Pearson correlation, require positive variance in both complete vectors, negate the single correlation once, and apply no other transform.
selected_mechanism.bar_rule: All 240 selected opens and closes must be finite and strictly positive.
selected_mechanism.missing_rule: Any duplicated, missing, or off-grid source row; invalid open or close; nonfinite body, gap, covariance, variance, correlation, or score; zero vector variance; or score outside [-1,1] beyond 1e-12 makes the stock-day missing.

overlap_challenges.reason: Campaign016 correlates the incoming gap g_t with the body b_t of the same destination bar and keeps the raw correlation sign. Campaign047 correlates a completed body b_t with the following gap g_(t+1) and negates the lagged relation; the causal ordering and paired observations differ.

Campaign041 conditions on nonzero incoming gaps and counts whether the prior close lies inside the destination bar high-low range. Campaign047 reads no high/low, retains zero gaps, and uses continuous signed body/gap magnitudes in one population correlation.
Campaign024 relates a current body to the next bar's unsigned high-low range. Campaign047 relates the body to the signed next opening discontinuity, reads no high/low, and freezes a reversal sign.

Campaign046 and the variance/sign families operate on adjacent between-close returns. Campaign047 decomposes a bar move and the next transition at raw opens and closes, uses one lagged cross-component Pearson correlation, and never forms adjacent close-return products or multi-minute sums.

Those mechanisms use high-low boundaries, body-to-range efficiency, or accumulated breakout distances. Campaign047 uses neither ranges nor extrema and measures only sequential body-to-next-gap correction.
Campaign047 explicitly resets at lunch and excludes 09:30. It contains no auction, midday anchor, terminal displacement, or cross-lunch move.

Campaign047 contains no volume, amount, VWAP, transaction price, peer benchmark, disclosure field, or prospective ledger input. Candidate49 remains future-only and enters only as a no-return comparison.
Campaign047 contains one exact raw open-close statistic and no terminal factor value, fitted weight, filter, threshold, regime, combination, or model.

decision.next_action: Bind this record, append terminal Campaign046 to the inherited 69-factor order, freeze one exact post-admission development trial, and run the binding validator before implementation.
